name: g_screenEffectSepiaColor
comment: Default RGB color vector [0.9f, 0.5f, 0.25f] used for the cutscene sepia screen effect (CSScreenEffectType mode 2); copied into Gfx_Context+0x1208..0x1210 by ScreenEffect_SetFade and ScreenEffect_ResetFade.
evidence: Initialized to {0.9f, 0.5f, 0.25f} at 0x00694B10 via vstmia {s0,s1,s2}; loaded by ScreenEffect_SetFade (0x00284674, literal 0x00284768) when mode == 2 to set Gfx_Context+0x1208..0x1210, and by ScreenEffect_ResetFade (0x002845D0, literal 0x00284670); paired with Script_Bind_ScreenEffectSetSepiaMul (0x007043F0) which modulates Gfx_Context+0x1214.
